# apple_beta_app_localization (Resource)

Sets the TestFlight test information of an app for one locale: the beta app description and the links and email testers see. An app has one localization per locale.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_beta_app_localization" "en" {
  app_id             = data.apple_app.example.id
  locale             = "en-US"
  description        = "Example helps you test examples."
  feedback_email     = "beta@example.com"
  marketing_url      = "https://example.com"
  privacy_policy_url = "https://example.com/privacy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app. Changing it creates a new localization.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`. Changing it creates a new localization.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Beta app description: what the app does and what to test.
- `feedback_email` (String) Email address testers send feedback to.
- `marketing_url` (String) Marketing URL of the app.
- `privacy_policy_url` (String) URL of the app's privacy policy.
- `tvos_privacy_policy` (String) Privacy policy text for tvOS, which cannot open URLs.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_beta_app_localization.en
  identity = {
    id = "1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_beta_app_localization.en 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
```
